purpose: Provide a registry-ready private MCP/tool listing package that a machine, registry reviewer or integration partner can evaluate without public registry submission, hosted MCP launch, live billing, production credentials, outreach or real data processing.

public_positioning_already_applied.description: Machine-first lead opportunity scoring API for CRMs, AI agents, MCP clients and workflows. Sandbox-only beta: no outreach or live billing.

draft_or_future_items_to_monitor: 2026-07-28 release candidate: stateless protocol core, extensions framework, tasks, MCP Apps, authorization hardening and JSON Schema 2020-12 for tools
official_mcp_context_checked.implementation_decision_now: Use local stdio adapter and tool-style manifest now. Do not claim hosted public MCP until a dedicated security, authorization, rate-limit and conformance gate passes.

registry_listing.name: MachineSignal Lead Opportunity Score
registry_listing.short_description: Machine-first lead opportunity scoring, target discovery and action-pack decision tool for CRMs, AI agents, MCP clients and automated workflows.
registry_listing.long_description: MachineSignal helps customer machines decide which companies or domains deserve commercial attention. It exposes machine-readable products for target discovery, lead opportunity scoring, domain enrichment, deep analysis and CRM/workflow action packs. The current channel is sandbox/private-draft only: local stdio adapter available, hosted public MCP not live, registry submission blocked, live billing disabled, production keys blocked, no external contact, no human outreach and no real customer or personal data processing.
registry_listing.primary_user: Machine: CRM, AI agent, workflow engine, enrichment pipeline, MCP client or software buyer.
registry_listing.human_role: Owner supervision, approval, legal/fiscal control and audit only.

transport_strategy.recommended_remote_transport_later: hosted MCP or streamable HTTP only after owner-approved security and authorization gate
remote_mcp_requirements_before_launch: conformance smoke tests against current MCP spec

registry_review_questions_and_answers.question: Is this a hosted public MCP server?
registry_review_questions_and_answers.answer: No. Current mode is local stdio adapter only.

registry_review_questions_and_answers.question: Can a machine test without talking to a human?
registry_review_questions_and_answers.answer: Yes, via sandbox/private beta flow and public read-only docs, but this draft review itself performs no sandbox writes.

registry_review_questions_and_answers.question: Can this listing take payments?
registry_review_questions_and_answers.answer: No. Live billing, subscriptions, invoices and production keys are blocked.

registry_review_questions_and_answers.question: Does Action Pack send emails or contact targets?
registry_review_questions_and_answers.answer: No. It produces payloads and approval gates; it does not send emails or execute external contact.

registry_review_questions_and_answers.question: Does this process personal data or real customer data now?
registry_review_questions_and_answers.answer: No. This private draft uses synthetic or public documentation only and blocks real data processing.

registry_review_questions_and_answers.question: What is the commercial object sold to machines?
registry_review_questions_and_answers.answer: Structured decisions and machine-readable outputs: target discovery, score, enrichment, deep analysis and action payloads.

machine_decision.recommended_next_step: Run the v2 NoPublish/NoWrite probe. If it passes, keep this as the current private registry-ready draft. Do not submit externally until an owner-approved go-live gate is completed.
